bullets: • Sanitize patch generation output; strip invalid control characters from JSON serialization.
• Validate patch JSON parseability before Hermes submission; reject malformed formatting.
• Distinguish code logic errors from patch formatting errors; debug separately.
• Build features incrementally; ensure new patches integrate cleanly with prior versions.

• CRITICAL: test_results is an array of {status, message} objects — NEVER use String(item.test_results) or compare it as a string. Always check: Array.isArray(item.test_results) && item.test_results.some(t => t.status === 'pass'). String() gives '[object Object]' and will always be false.
